caption: A car drives along a road with the morning sun on its left, and its shadow runs along the ground on its right.

sa.check: A car drives along a road.
The morning sun is on its left.
Its shadow runs along the ground on its right.
The shadow stays attached at the wheels.
The shadow moves with the car.

pc.expect: The shadow stays on the car's right, attached at the wheels, and moves with the car.
pc.fail: It is on the left with the sun on the left; or it switches sides while the sun stays put; or it lags or is detached.

pc.expect: The shadow keeps the car's outline and its wheels turn in step.
pc.fail: It is a different vehicle's shape; or its wheels are still; or it splits.

pc.expect: The shadow does not move on its own.
pc.fail: It moves with the car stopped; or changes length with the car still.

pc.expect: The car travels steadily along the road.
pc.fail: It jumps position; or moves backward; or swerves with no cause.
A second car or shadow appears; or the car vanishes; or the shadow becomes solid; or the car passes through a sign.

pc.expect: The car's colour and the road stay the same, and the shadow stays dark.
pc.fail: The car changes colour; or the shadow turns coloured; or the road markings shift.
